evals.name: site-induction-from-raw-notes
evals.prompt: I run a gas distribution company and I need a short induction for new field engineers — the kind of thing they work through on a laptop before their first site visit. Cover: why isolation matters, the four-step isolation procedure, what the gauge readings actually mean, and never working alone on a live line. Make it something I can email as one file, no server, works offline. Our brand colour is #C1442A and we're called Meridian Gas.
evals.expected_output: A single standalone HTML flipbook built with the skill, using several distinct layouts appropriate to the content (a flow diagram for the four-step procedure, a table or chart for gauge readings, a takeaway for the never-work-alone rule), rebranded to #C1442A via theme.json, with no placeholder text and no external references.

evals.name: content-with-obvious-layout-shapes
evals.prompt: Turn this into an interactive handbook page set. I have: a project timeline (Jan kickoff, Mar prototype, Jun pilot, Sep rollout), a before/after comparison of our old vs new approval process, a table of the four approval tiers with their limits, and a quote from our CEO I want on its own page. Single HTML file please.
evals.expected_output: A book where each piece of content lands on the layout that matches its SHAPE — timeline block for the dated sequence, a compare pair on facing pages for old vs new, a Markdown table for the tiers, and a quote page for the CEO line. Not all prose, and not the wrong layouts.

evals.name: vague-ask-plus-branding
evals.prompt: can you make me one of those flip book training things for our safety team? needs to look like our brand (dark blue, orange accent) and I want to be able to click through it in a meeting room with a presenter clicker
evals.expected_output: A built flipbook with a theme.json rebranded to dark blue + orange, presenter-remote support confirmed, and the assistant should have asked for or invented sensible content rather than shipping template placeholders.
